content.hebrew: אֱמֶת, אֵל מֵאַֽיִן לְיֵשׁ בְּחַסְדּוֹ הִמְצִיאָֽנוּ,
content.transliteration: Emet El me’ayin leyesh beḥasdo himtsi’anu,
content.english: In truth, God in His mercy brought us into existence from nothingness,

content.hebrew: הוּא חִבֵּר גָּלְמֵֽנוּ בְּעָצְמַת יָדוֹ וְהִפְלִיאָֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Hu ḥibber golmenu be‘otsmat yado vehifli’anu.
content.english: He fashioned our unformed substance with His mighty hand, and dealt wondrously with us.

content.hebrew: רָקַם צַלְמֵֽנוּ מֵאֲדָמָה, וּמִמָּרוֹם נְשָׁמָה הֱבִיאָֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Raḳam tsalmenu me’adama, umimmarom neshama hevi’anu.
content.english: He wove our image out of earth, and brought us a soul from on high.

content.hebrew: נִהֲלָֽנוּ חוֹק וּמִשְׁפָּט, לֹא תֹֽהוּ בְּרָאָֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Nihalanu ḥoḳ umishpat, lo tohu bera’anu.
content.english: He guided us with statutes and ordinances—He did not create us in vain.
He loved us with extra fondness, and called us to [accept] His Torah.

content.hebrew: זִכְרוֹן שָׂם עַל בְּשָׂרֵֽנוּ, וַיָּֽרֶם שִׂיאֵֽנוּ.
content.english: He has placed a remembrance on our flesh and greatly elevated us.

content.hebrew: קִדְּשָֽׁנוּ מִכָּל־גּוֹי וְצִוָּֽנוּ לְהִמּוֹל בַּשְּׁמִינִי, מִפִּי נְבִיאֵֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Ḳiddeshanu mikkol goy vetsivvanu lehimmol bash’shemini, mippi nevi’enu.
content.english: He has sanctified us out of all the nations, and commanded us, through our prophet, to be circumcised on the eighth day.
And regarding a woman who has given birth or one afflicted [with lepra]—He has kept us away from every holy thing,
content.comments: Lepra. Hebrew ẓara‘ath, a skin disease discussed in the Torah that is not leprosy.

content.hebrew: עַד מְלֹאת חֶסְרוֹן כַּפָּרָתָהּ בְּקָרְבָּנָהּ, כַּאֲשֶׁר הֶרְאָֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: ‘ad melot ḥesron kapparatah beḳorbanah, ka’asher her’anu.
content.english: Until that which she lacks from her atonement is filled through her sacrifice, as He has shown us.
And He has made us pure, and not impure, from the appearances of [skin] afflictions—
He has prevented us from walking amidst His people as lepers.

content.hebrew: וְעַל נִגְעֵי בְגָדִים שָׂם אוֹת לְיָרְאֵֽנוּ,
content.transliteration: Ve‘al niḡ‘ē veḡadim sam ot leyare’enu,
content.english: And regarding afflictions of garments, He has made a marking to frighten us,
In the types [of fabric] for which he has restricted us through prohibition.

content.hebrew: לֹא עָשָׂה כֵן לְכָל־גּוֹי; בְּתוֹרוֹת נִשְּׂאָֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Lo ‘asa khen lekhol goy; betorot nisse’anu.
content.english: He did not do so for any [other] nation; He has made us lofty with His teachings,

content.hebrew: וְעָלֵֽינוּ לְהוֹדוֹת שְׁמוֹ בְּכָל־עֵת, כִּי הוּא גֹּאֲלֵנוּ.
content.transliteration: Ve‘alenu lehodot shemo bekhol ‘et, ki hu go’alenu.
content.english: And we must give thanks to His name at all times, for He is our redeemer.

content.hebrew: קהל: גֹּאֵל יִשְׂרָאֵל מְבָרֵךְ יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי, מְהֵרָה יִגְאָלֵֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Go’el Yisra’el mevarekh yom hash’shevi‘i, mehara yiḡ’alenu.
content.english: Cong. Israel’s redeemer, who blesses the seventh day—may He soon redeem us!

content.hebrew: חזן: יֹ֭אמְר֖וּ גְּאוּלֵ֣י יו֑י אֲשֶׁ֥ר גְּ֝אָלָ֗ם מִיַּד־צָֽר:
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Yomeru ge’ulē Adonai asher ge’alam miyyad tsar:
content.english: Cantor: Let those redeemed by Adonai say that He has redeemed them from the enemy’s hand. (Ps. 107:2)

content.hebrew: קהל: גֹּֽאֲלֵ֕נוּ יו֥י צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑וֹ קְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל:
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Go’alenu Adonai tseva’ot shemo ḳedosh Yisra’el:
content.english: Congregation: Our redeemer, Adonai Ẓeva’oth is His name, the Holy One of Israel. (Isa. 47:4)
content.comments: Adonai Ẓeva’oth. A common name for God in Scripture; traditional English: “Lord of Hosts.”
